result.instructions: Tools for SmartBill, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Has invoice FCT 0042 been paid, and how much is still owed?"; "Which VAT rates are set up in my billing account?"; "How much stock do we have in each warehouse today?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SmartBill data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run smartbill_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run smartbill_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run smartbill_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. smartbill_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: smartbill_list_series
tools.title: List document series
tools.description: List the document series configured in SmartBill Cloud with their next number. Invoice and proforma tools need a series name from here. type: f = invoice series, p = proforma, c = receipt (chitanta); omit for all. GET /series.

type.description: f = invoices, p = proformas, c = receipts; omit for all.

tools.name: smartbill_list_taxes
tools.title: List VAT rates (V1)
tools.description: List the VAT rates configured in the account (name and percentage). Use the name as tax_name and the percentage as tax_percentage on document lines. Works without a V3 token. GET /tax.

tools.name: smartbill_get_stock
tools.title: Get stock levels
tools.description: Stock quantities per warehouse as of a date (needs the SmartBill stock module). Optional filters: warehouse_name (case-sensitive), product_name, product_code. No filters = all products in all warehouses. GET /stocks.

date.description: Date yyyy-mm-dd the stock is read at.

tools.name: smartbill_get_invoice_payment_status
tools.title: Get invoice payment status
tools.description: Whether an invoice is paid and how much remains: invoiceTotalAmount, paidAmount, unpaidAmount and the paid flag. GET /invoice/paymentstatus.

series_name.description: Document series name exactly as configured in SmartBill Cloud (smartbill_list_series lists them).

number.description: Document number as text, e.g. "0025" (keep leading zeros).

tools.name: smartbill_get_estimate_invoices
tools.title: Get invoices of a proforma
tools.description: Whether a proforma was invoiced and the invoices (series, number) made from it. A draft invoice shows with an empty number. GET /estimate/invoices.

tools.name: smartbill_list_clients
tools.title: List or search clients
tools.description: List clients from the SmartBill client list, optionally filtered by name (partial, case-insensitive), internal code (exact) or CIF (exact). Needs the API V3 token. Cursor paged: pass the reply's next_args as the next call's arguments. GET /v3/companies/{cif}/clients.

after.description: Cursor: continue after this id (use next_args from the previous reply). Not together with before.

before.description: Cursor: go back before this id (use previous_args). Not together with after.

tools.name: smartbill_get_client
tools.title: Get a client
tools.description: One client by V3 id (cus_...): name, CIF, address, bank, contact, VAT-payer flag and delivery addresses. Needs the API V3 token. GET /v3/companies/{cif}/clients/{id}.

id.description: The client id (cus_...), from the list tool.

tools.title: List or search suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers, optionally filtered by name (partial), internal code (exact) or CIF (exact). Needs the API V3 token. Cursor paged: pass the reply's next_args as the next call's arguments. GET /v3/companies/{cif}/suppliers.

after.description: Cursor: continue after this id (use next_args from the previous reply). Not together with before.

before.description: Cursor: go back before this id (use previous_args). Not together with after.

tools.name: smartbill_get_supplier
tools.title: Get a supplier
tools.description: One supplier by V3 id (sup_...). Needs the API V3 token. GET /v3/companies/{cif}/suppliers/{id}.

id.description: The supplier id (sup_...), from the list tool.

tools.name: smartbill_list_products
tools.title: List or search products and services
tools.description: List the product and service catalog (price, unit, VAT rate, currency), optionally filtered by name (whole-word match) or internal code (exact). Needs the API V3 token. Cursor paged: pass the reply's next_args as the next call's arguments. GET /v3/companies/{cif}/products.

tools.title: List VAT rates (V3)

tools.name: smartbill_create_invoice
tools.title: Create an invoice
tools.description: Create an invoice for a client with product/service lines. By default it is saved as a DRAFT (no number) for review in SmartBill Cloud. With draft=false the invoice is ISSUED: it takes the next number of the series, cannot be deleted or edited through this server, can only be cancelled or reversed (storno), and, depending on the account's e-Factura setup, may be transmitted to ANAF. Confirm every field with the user before draft=false. Returns series, number, documentId, documentUrl (needs login) and documentViewUrl (public PDF link). POST /invoice/v2.

series_name.description: Document series name exactly as configured in SmartBill Cloud (smartbill_list_series lists them).

vat_code.description: Client CUI/CIF or foreign VAT code.

is_tax_payer.description: Client is a VAT payer (default false: stored as non-payer).

city.description: City. When county is Bucuresti this must be Sector 1 - Sector 6, or e-Factura will not validate in SPV.

country.description: Country name or usual code (default Romania).

save_to_db.description: Also save the client in the SmartBill client list when new (default false).

client.description: The client the document is issued to.

code.description: Product code (SKU); required when the account has "use product code" enabled.

quantity.description: Quantity, greater than 0 (the API itself accepts 0 and negatives; this server does not).

unit.description: Unit of measure as configured in SmartBill, e.g. buc, ora, kg.

price.description: Unit price: WITHOUT VAT unless is_tax_included is true.

is_tax_included.description: The price already includes VAT (default false).

tax_name.description: VAT rate name as in the account (smartbill_list_taxes), e.g. Normala.

tax_percentage.description: VAT percentage of the line, e.g. 21, 11, 0.

exchange_rate.description: Exchange rate to RON (default: SmartBill's rate for the date).

draft.description: Default TRUE: the document is saved as a draft without a number, to be finalized in SmartBill Cloud. Pass false ONLY when the user explicitly wants it ISSUED now: that takes the next number of the series, cannot be undone from the API, and may be transmitted to e-Factura / ANAF depending on the account setup.

tools.name: smartbill_create_invoice_from_estimate
tools.title: Create an invoice from a proforma
tools.description: Create an invoice from an existing proforma (client and lines are copied from it). Default is a DRAFT; with draft=false the invoice is ISSUED with the next number of the series and may be transmitted to e-Factura / ANAF. Stock is not discharged. POST /invoice/v2 (useEstimateDetails).

estimate_number.description: Number of the source proforma as text.

draft.description: Default TRUE: the document is saved as a draft without a number, to be finalized in SmartBill Cloud. Pass false ONLY when the user explicitly wants it ISSUED now: that takes the next number of the series, cannot be undone from the API, and may be transmitted to e-Factura / ANAF depending on the account setup.

tools.name: smartbill_reverse_invoice
tools.title: Reverse an invoice (storno)
tools.description: ISSUE a storno (credit) invoice that reverses an issued invoice. It takes the next number, an invoice can be reversed only once, and the storno cannot be undone; it may be transmitted to e-Factura / ANAF. Confirm the exact series and number with the user first. POST /invoice/reverse.

series_name.description: Series of the invoice to reverse.

number.description: Number of the invoice to reverse, as text.

issue_date.description: Date of the storno invoice yyyy-mm-dd (default today; not before the original's date).

tools.name: smartbill_cancel_invoice
tools.title: Cancel an invoice
tools.description: Cancel an existing invoice (it stays in the books as cancelled; smartbill_restore_invoice undoes it). Changes the document's fiscal status, so confirm with the user. PUT /invoice/cancel.

series_name.description: Document series name exactly as configured in SmartBill Cloud (smartbill_list_series lists them).

number.description: Document number as text, e.g. "0025" (keep leading zeros).

tools.name: smartbill_restore_invoice
tools.title: Restore a cancelled invoice
tools.description: Restore an invoice that was cancelled, making it active again. PUT /invoice/restore.

series_name.description: Document series name exactly as configured in SmartBill Cloud (smartbill_list_series lists them).

number.description: Document number as text, e.g. "0025" (keep leading zeros).

tools.name: smartbill_cancel_estimate
tools.title: Cancel a proforma
tools.description: Cancel an existing proforma (smartbill_restore_estimate undoes it). PUT /estimate/cancel.

tools.name: smartbill_restore_estimate
tools.title: Restore a cancelled proforma
tools.description: Restore a proforma that was cancelled. PUT /estimate/restore.

tools.name: smartbill_record_invoice_payment
tools.title: Record a payment against invoices
tools.description: Record a collection (incasare) against one or more issued invoices; client and amount are taken from the invoices. With value (single invoice only) a partial payment is recorded. type Chitanta issues a numbered RECEIPT on receipt_series (cannot be undone from this server); the other types (Card, Ordin plata, ...) record the payment without a document. It changes the invoice's paid status in the books: confirm with the user. Fiscal receipts (Bon) are not supported. POST /payment.

series_name.description: Document series name exactly as configured in SmartBill Cloud (smartbill_list_series lists them).

number.description: Document number as text, e.g. "0025" (keep leading zeros).

type.description: Payment type. Chitanta = a numbered receipt (needs receipt_series); the others create no document.

receipt_series.description: Receipt series; required for type Chitanta (smartbill_list_series with type c).

value.description: Partial amount, for a single invoice only; omit to collect the invoice's full amount.

is_cash.description: Mark the collection as cash (typically for Chitanta).

tools.name: smartbill_send_document
tools.title: Email an invoice or proforma
tools.description: Send an issued invoice or proforma by email from SmartBill. This EMAILS A THIRD PARTY and cannot be recalled. Without `to` it goes to the client's email on the document; without subject/body_text the account's email template is used. Confirm the recipient with the user first. POST /document/send.

series_name.description: Document series name exactly as configured in SmartBill Cloud (smartbill_list_series lists them).

number.description: Document number as text, e.g. "0025" (keep leading zeros).

to.description: Recipient (default: the client's email on the document).

subject.description: Email subject, plain text (default: the account template).

body_text.description: Email body, plain text (default: the account template).
